newsitem.title: USA: Outlook Group plans to sell two units.
newsitem.headline: Outlook Group plans to sell two units.

text.p: Outlook Group Corp said Thursday it plans to divest two of its subsidiaries, Outlook Foods Inc of Oconomowoc, Wis. and Barrier Films Corp of Reno, Nev.

"It is our intention to sell both Outlook Foods and Barrier Films to parties who bring additional knowledge and experience to these specific industries," Outlook chairman and president David Erdmann said in a statement.
Outlook said specific arrangements have not been made, but the company expects to complete the transactions over the next six months.
Outlook said the divestures are part of the company's strategic plan to focus its resources in its packaging and graphics operations.
Outlook Foods produces powdered food and beverage products, and Barrier Films produces films for food packaging.
